name: @activepieces/piece-tavily
description: Search engine tailored for AI agents.

auth.description:
Follow these steps to obtain your Tavily API Key:

1. Visit [tavily](https://tavily.com/) and create an account.
2. Log in and navigate to your dashboard.
3. Locate and copy your API key from the dashboard.

search.name: search
search.description: Search for data based on a query.

query.description: The search query you want to execute with Tavily.

search_depth.description: The depth of the search. It can be "basic" or "advanced".

topic.description: The category of the search. This will determine which of our agents will be used for the search.

days.description: The number of days back from the current date to include in the search results. Only available when using the "news" search topic. Default is 3.

time_range.description: The time range back from the current date to include in the search results.

max_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return.

include_images.description: Include a list of query-related images in the response.

include_image_descriptions.description: When include_images is set to True, this option adds descriptive text for each image.

include_answer.description: Include a short answer to original query, generated by an LLM based on Tavily's search results.

include_raw_content.description: Include the cleaned and parsed HTML content of each search result.

include_domains.description: A list of domains to specifically include in the search results.

exclude_domains.description: A list of domains to specifically exclude from the search results.

aiMetadata.description: Run a web search through the Tavily search engine for a natural-language query and return relevant results; tune scope with search depth, a general vs. news topic, recency windows, and domain include/exclude lists, and optionally include images, raw page content, or an LLM-generated answer summary. Use to look up current or external information from the web. Read-only and idempotent: the same query returns equivalent results without side effects, though live web data may shift over time.

extract.name: extract
extract.description: Retrieve raw web content from specified URLs.

urls.description: The URLs you want to extract with Tavily.

include_images.description: Include a list of images extracted from the URLs in the response.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch and return the cleaned, parsed content of one or more specific web pages by passing their URLs, optionally including images found on those pages. Use when you already have exact URLs (e.g. from a prior search) and need their full text rather than performing a new query. Read-only and idempotent: repeating the call with the same URLs has no side effects.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

nl.Include a list of query-related images i: Voeg een lijst met query-gerelateerde afbeeldingen toe in het antwoord.

nl.A list of domains to specifically exclud: Een lijst van domeinen om specifiek uit te sluiten van de zoekresultaten.

nl.Include a list of images extracted from: Voeg een lijst van afbeeldingen toe uit de URL's in het antwoord.
